_comment: BAND-SPLIT-2. `clearings` and `footprints` cut from data/config/vegetation.json, merged back by scripts/data/band_content.gd. `order` equals the index each entry held in the pre-split file, so the merge reproduces it exactly -- see tests/test_band_vegetation.gd.

clearings._why: the village square and its structures
the practice meadow: the opening's bramblebun and the arena around it

R8.1: the practice trainer's ground north of the square (data/config/trainers.json). Same reason as the entries above -- a trainer battle's arena is 11m across and forms between the player and the creature their opponent just sent out, so without this the fight is watched through a tree. Most of it already falls inside the village square's own 22m clearing; this covers the northern edge that does not.

clearings._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (clearings[5]). NOT explicitly named in the macro-layout doc's table (which lists `vegetation.footprints[2,3]` for the mill group but not this clearing), moved anyway to avoid leaving a stale tree-free clearing at the old (-133.5,110) once the mill/footbridge move to (-383.5,517).
clearings._why: EV6-remainder: the mill and its crossing -- keeps trees/rocks off the pad and the bridge approaches

clearings._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (clearings[6]), same reasoning as clearings[5] above: not named explicitly in the table but moved to track the ranger station.
clearings._why: EV6-remainder: the ranger station and its yard on the pond route
SC14: the South Bridge and both its abutment aprons -- a tree or a boulder on either rim would stand between the player and the one thing the whole south road exists to show them
clearings._comment_ow5d: OW5D: translated with south_bridge crossings[0] by the same (-5,+1250).
clearings._comment_ow5c_seam: OW5C follow-up: shifted +8 in x with south_bridge crossings[0] (WALL1 seam workaround).

clearings._why: BAND1-D1: the trail_camp prop cluster (props.json order 1000) at the spine's (360,910) bend -- same treatment every other authored prop cluster in this file gets, so the rest stop's pack/crate/barrel pile is not itself buried by the scatter pass. NOTE for the coordinator: scatter_bake.gd's config_fingerprint() does not hash this file (GATE_D_LANE_CONTRACT.md section 4's known defect), so this clearing does not by itself invalidate the current bake -- it needs the same fingerprint fix and single re-bake every band's new clearing does.

footprints._why: Grandpa's house, 9x7m inside plus walls -- grass was standing on the floor and the rug

the windmill -- at distance sqrt(18^2+14^2)=22.8m from the village-square clearing's own centre, just outside its 22m radius, so the rocks layer (which DOES respect clearings, unlike grass) could still land a boulder against its base. R9.4-remainder-8's survey found one doing exactly that, obscuring village.json's own stated landmark from the meadow view.

footprints._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (footprints[2], docs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2): (-132,107) -> (-382,514), same offset as the mill.
footprints._why: the mill -- grass out of the tower and from under the wheel

footprints._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (footprints[3]): (-136.3,113) -> (-386.3,520), same offset as the footbridge.
footprints._why: the footbridge -- grass off the deck and both stone landings

footprints._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (footprints[4]): (-100,100) -> (-350,507), same offset as the ranger station.

footprints._why: SC14: the South Bridge's deck and both stone landings -- the same treatment the mill's footbridge already gets, at this span's own half-length

R7.9: the inn, 6x10m plus walls (half-diagonal 5.83m) -- same footprint class as Grandpa's house above and given the same margin. Found the same way Grandpa's own entry was: a tools/capture_inn.gd render showed grass standing on the common room's floor and rug. Site moved once already (village.json's own `_why` on the `inn` structure records why); this entry has to move with it or it excludes nothing the inn actually stands on.
